name: whatbreaks
description: Reviews a Terraform, OpenTofu, or Terragrunt plan before you apply it: what is destroyed or replaced (and whether data is lost), what opens to the internet, which protections or IAM limits are loosened, ranked by severity with a fix for each. Bundled offline analyzer; nothing leaves your machine. In Claude Code and Cowork an apply gate refuses terraform apply until that exact plan file has been reviewed.

apply_gate.title: Block terraform apply until the plan is reviewed
apply_gate.description: When on, a hook denies terraform, tofu, and terragrunt apply/destroy in Claude Code and Cowork until the exact plan file has been reviewed with /whatbreaks:review (or approved with /whatbreaks:approve after a BLOCK verdict). Turn off to keep only the review skills (Claude Code only; Cowork cannot change plugin options).
